ideas.pitch: An AI-powered companion tool for competitive programmers that visualizes algorithm execution steps and estimates time complexity classes from raw source code.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer & Complexity Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the pain points of participants in intense competitive programming contests like Code N Compete by offering immediate logic debugging and execution insights.

ideas.pitch: A localized platform for hosting impromptu speed-coding rounds with automated test case generation and real-time comparative performance analytics.
ideas.title: AlgoBattle Matchmaker & Performance Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the spirit of the high-intensity competitive programming challenges at Techkriti'27, providing an immediate working demo for practice.

ideas.pitch: An automated code execution tracer that flags potential edge-case failures, infinite loops, and integer overflow issues before submission.
ideas.title: CodeTrace AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and logic error prevention, which are critical winning metrics in timed 2-hour competitive programming finales.

ideas.pitch: A multi-platform unified leaderboard and real-time submission parser that aggregates competitive programming standings across multiple problem sets.
ideas.title: ContestHub Live Leaderboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a robust, fully working dashboard that handles live data streams efficiently, appealing to judges who value solid technical execution under tight time constraints.

ideas.pitch: A smart snippet manager for competitive programmers that auto-indexes algorithms, data structures, and boilerplate templates with instant copy-paste hotkeys.
ideas.title: SnippetVault & CP Template Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact logistical bottleneck of saving time during high-pressure coding rounds where every second counts.
